Kaggle lists the ARC Prize 2025 entry on Jack Cole's profile as 3rd of 1,455 teams with a gold medal. The entry shows five accounts (jcole75, driessmit1, pressman1, moeosman and michaelhodel), so the gold is a team result.

Jack Cole's two bronze medals on Kaggle are The 2026 NeuroGolf Championship (184th of 2,963 teams) and ROGII - Wellbore Geology Prediction (411th of 6,125 teams). Each entry shows only the jcole75 account.

NT competes as mitubant with Team Turducken in ARC-AGI-3.
NT, who uses the Kaggle handle mitubant, joined Kaggle in November 2018 and is a Competitions Expert with three silver and two bronze competition medals, ranked 1,723rd of 225,021.

Kaggle lists the team entry that includes NT in The 2026 NeuroGolf Championship, a contest about the smallest neural networks that solve ARC-AGI puzzles, 18th of 2,963 teams with a silver medal. The entry shows five accounts: nahman, evilpsycho42, mitubant, calibrator and russcore; it is a team medal, not NT's solo result.

NT's other two silver medals are team entries: ROGII Wellbore Geology Prediction, 171st of 6,125 teams, listed with ngyzly, yichengs, zzxhee and huangshunhao; and Kaggriculture, 302nd of 10,148 teams, listed with ngyzly, keithtyser, hdhsjdjd and dzjiann.

NT's two bronze medals are from the Pokémon Company PTCG AI Battle Challenge, 523rd of 6,807 teams, listed with ngyzly, and RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection, 540th of 6,299 teams, where only the mitubant account is shown.
NT's Kaggle competitions page lists both ARC Prize 2026 - ARC-AGI-3 and ARC Prize 2026 - ARC-AGI-2 among his five active competitions.
